title: tests.py --set-profile refuses an IDE terminal without naming the standalone-terminal route the ceiling refusal gives
goal: the refusal tests.py --set-profile prints in an agent session or an IDE integrated terminal ends with bl_authority.IDE_ROUTE, as the ceiling gate refusal does, so an operator in a VS Code terminal learns to open a standalone terminal

run: import subprocess,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/tests.py','--set-profile','busy'],capture_output=True,text=True);print(p.stderr.strip());sys.exit(0 if bl_authority.IDE_ROUTE in p.stderr else 1)
